description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Berkeley Lab Intellectual Property Office – Intellectual Property Office Skip to main content Complaint Resolution & Whistleblower Protection Act Working with You to License Berkeley Lab Technology Whether your goal is to launch a company, improve a product line, or maintain industry competitiveness, cutting-edge Berkeley Lab technologies can be part of the solution. The Intellectual Property Office helps Lab researchers bring Berkeley Lab’s science solutions to the world through the following services: technology transfer and licensing, NDAs and MTAs, and entrepreneurship training. Explore licensing opportunities for our innovative, Lab-developed intellectual property. We partner with companies, at any stage, that have the technical and financial expertise to transform early-stage technologies into successful commercial products.
